title: SiteCreate
description: Payload to create a site within an organization. Server fills id/audit fields.

siteType.description: Site type. Use 'awsCloud' for AWS cloud discovery sites.

awsRegion.description: AWS region for this site (required when siteType=awsCloud; omitted for OnPrem).

awsAccountId.description: AWS account ID for this site (required when siteType=awsCloud; omitted for OnPrem).

address.description: Postal address for OnPrem sites. Omit for awsCloud sites.
